name: landing-page-copy
description:
Produces conversion-optimized landing page copy with hero section, problem
statement, solution, social proof, and CTA sections using conversion
copywriting methodology. Use when the user asks to write landing page copy,
create a product page, write a sales page, draft conversion copy, or
write landing page text for a website. Also useful when asked to write
website copy or create a page that converts visitors.
Do NOT use for ad copy (use paid-ad-copy), product descriptions for
e-commerce listings (use product-description), or full website content
strategy (use seo-content-strategy).
